basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: A quantity value is a number bound to a unit and a quantity kind; neither is meaningful alone.
It differs from a measurement or observation, which adds method, time and subject.
Money amounts belong to the money model; currency is not a unit of measure here.
Precision and exactness are part of the value and are preserved end to end.

may: Parse and canonicalise unit expressions against a pinned registry release.
Convert between commensurable units and record the conversion.
Render quantities for presentation in the reader's conventions.
mustNot: Store or exchange a number without its unit.
Convert unknown or arbitrary units by guessing.
Round or drop significant digits silently.
Overwrite the original recorded value with its canonical form.
Compare quantities of different kinds or scale types.
requiresHuman: Mapping an unknown inbound unit code.
Deciding conformity against a safety-critical specification.

considerations: Unit errors in medicine, engineering and aviation have caused deaths; accuracy here is a safety matter.
Misleading units in consumer information hurt buyers.
affectedParties: People relying on dosages and measurements

items: A quantity value carries a number, a unit symbol or code and a quantity kind.
Confused with a dimensionless count, a currency amount, a code that looks numeric and a value with an implied default unit.
Wrong conversions causing overdoses or structural failures.
The International System of Units (SI) Brochure, BIPM.
UCUM Unified Code for Units of Measure.
QUDT quantities, units, dimensions and types ontology.
